tools.name: search_intelligence
tools.title: Search Deepgrain Intelligence
tools.description: Search the Deepgrain Intelligence library (essays, guides, glossary, answers) for a keyword or phrase. Returns matching article slugs with a short snippet around the first hit.

query.description: Keyword or short phrase to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching articles to return. Default 8.

tools.name: fetch_article
tools.title: Fetch a Deepgrain article
tools.description: Fetch a Deepgrain page by URL or an Intelligence article by slug. Returns the raw HTML so the caller can parse or cite it.

urlOrSlug.description: A full https://www.deepgrain.ai URL, or an Intelligence article slug like 'ai-operating-ladder-five-tiers'.

tools.name: list_pillars
tools.title: List Deepgrain pillar essays
tools.description: List the canonical Deepgrain pillar essays. Use this as the entry point when a caller wants an overview of the Deepgrain point of view before drilling into specific articles.
